notes.title: Iron Crypticle is getting a PS4 Physical release!
notes.notes:
Limited Run Games will be releasing a small limited edition run of the game for PS4.

It will come with a game manual and reversible box cover art!
[b]Do check out their site on 8th June 2018 to see if you can snag a copy :D[/b]

https://limitedrungames.com/products/limited-run-151-iron-crypticle-ps4

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29618213/e66d8eb02d7b16c3e92f3b88f856e1d74f8b42fe.jpg[/img]

notes.title: IRON CRYPTICLE Patch 1.01.05 out now!
notes.notes:
[b]Below is a list of fixes and changes:[/b]
[list]
 [*]Fixed audio panning issue
 [*]Fixed achievement issues
 [*]Fixes for offline mode
 [*]Added scanline option (choose between Iron Fisticle-style "classic", or a TV CRT-style effect)
 [*]Visual change for dropped "egg" mines
 [*]CHOOSE YOUR CHARACTER from the 4 available. After pressing a key/button to join the game, you can use left/right to change character!
 [*]Other misc. bug fixes
[/list]
[i]Special thanks to Zelgaris for his help with reporting problems![/i]
